subject: SOC2: evidence scope and delivery plan for targeted authn/access artifacts
messages:
From: Clare Hall <clare.hall@medforge.com>
To: nikhil_sharma@redwood.ai
Cc: sara.miller@medforge.com
Date: 2026-03-03T09:12:00Z
Subject: Ask: scoped artifacts for SOC 2 Type II audit (MFA, session logs, access recert)

Hi Nikhil,

Thanks again for taking this — MedForge is in the middle of a SOC 2 Type II readiness window and our external auditors (Audits Inc) have asked us to collect a handful of scoped artifacts from vendors that map to authentication and access controls. For Redwood we need:  

- MFA enforcement evidence for interactive accounts (screenshots or logs showing policy enforcement + dates of enforcement/rollout)
- A scoped extract of session/authentication events for privileged roles (admin/service accounts) for 2025-09-01 to 2026-02-28 — we only need a sample extract (CSV) with timestamps, event type, username (pseudonym OK), source IP, and MFA flag.
- Recent quarterly access recertification artifacts (manager attestations or access review exports) covering Oct/2025 and Jan/2026
- A signed bridge letter confirming there were no material control exceptions outside of what’s disclosed in your SOC 2 Type II report covering the audit period ending 2026-02-28

Can you confirm you can provide these items and an estimated delivery date? Also let us know if pseudonymization (replacing user ids with consistent hashed ids) is acceptable for the session extract. Our auditors will accept pseudonymized user ids as long as the mapping is kept by the vendor for investigation.

Thanks — Clare
Clare Hall
Security Program Manager, MedForge
clare.hall@medforge.com

Attachments: none
From: nikhil_sharma <nikhil_sharma@redwood.ai>
To: Clare Hall <clare.hall@medforge.com>
Cc: priyom_das@redwood.ai, laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-03-03T12:45:00Z
Subject: Re: Ask: scoped artifacts for SOC 2 Type II audit (MFA, session logs, access recert)

Clare — thanks for the clear list. We can support all four asks but need to clarify a couple of details to scope exports and confirm delivery timeline:  

1) Audit window: you requested 2025-09-01 to 2026-02-28 — confirmed? That matches our retention windows but for very large tenants we typically provide a sampled slice (we can provide full slices for privileged roles).
2) Privileged role definition: please confirm which roles you consider "privileged" (e.g., tenant admins, org owners, support+ops accounts). If you don’t have a list we’ll default to accounts with the role tag admin/* and all service accounts with admin scope.
3) Pseudonymization: we can provide a consistently hashed user id column alongside a mapping key that we hold (not shared) — auditors accept that. Please confirm if you want us to include any email addresses in cleartext for the manager attestations export.
4) Bridge letter: we can produce a draft bridge_letter_draft.pdf for your review. Signing typically requires our legal/ops signoff — estimate 3 business days after scope is agreed.

Proposed delivery schedule (pending your confirmations above):
- Day 0: scope confirmed
- Day 1-2: exports prepared and pseudonymized
- Day 3: package uploaded to secure Drive + bridge letter draft uploaded for DocuSign

I’ll loop in Laura (compliance) to confirm export formats and Grace on the access review artifacts. Does that timeline work for MedForge's audit deadlines?

Best,
Nikhil Sharma
Sr. Security Engineer, Redwood Inference
nikhil_sharma@redwood.ai

Attachments: SOC2-TypeII-summary.pdf (stub - we will not include full report in initial upload)
From: Clare Hall <clare.hall@medforge.com>
To: nikhil_sharma@redwood.ai
Cc: sara.miller@medforge.com, security@audits-inc.com
Date: 2026-03-04T08:05:00Z
Subject: Re: Ask: scoped artifacts for SOC 2 Type II audit (MFA, session logs, access recert)

Thanks Nikhil — that approach looks good. A few clarifications from the auditor side:  

- Confirmed audit window is 2025-09-01 through 2026-02-28.
- Privileged roles: tenant administrators, org owners, and any accounts with grant scope "root" or "admin". If easier, include any account that performed role change events or group membership changes during the window.
- Pseudonymization: acceptable as long as the hashed id is stable and there is a separate salt you retain. Do NOT include user emails in the exported CSV for privacy reasons; manager attestations (access recert CSV) can include manager emails but only if you redact non-MedForge user emails.
- For session traces we need a minimum sample of 5,000 events or the full set for privileged roles if that is under 5k — whichever is smaller.

Auditor asks that exports be CSV with header columns: event_time, event_type, pseudonymous_user_id, source_ip, mfa_used, role_changes_flag, session_duration_seconds.

MedForge is working to the following internal deadline: package must be uploaded by 2026-03-10 to allow their review. If you can meet that, great. If not, please indicate earliest possible date.

-Clare
From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Clare Hall <clare.hall@medforge.com>, nikhil_sharma@redwood.ai
Cc: priyom_das@redwood.ai, grace_oconnor@redwood.ai, security@audits-inc.com
Date: 2026-03-05T16:30:00Z
Subject: Re: Ask: scoped artifacts for SOC 2 Type II audit (MFA, session logs, access recert) — delivery plan

Hi Clare — looping in Grace (Access Reviews) and Priyom (Engineering exports) so we can move forward. Confirming scope and delivery plan below based on your auditor requirements:  

Confirmed scope:
- Audit window: 2025-09-01 -> 2026-02-28
- Privileged accounts: tenant admins, org owners, accounts with role change events or group membership changes during the window
- Export columns: event_time, event_type, pseudonymous_user_id, source_ip, mfa_used (boolean), role_changes_flag, session_duration_seconds

Planned artifacts (bundle):
1) authn_session_sample.csv — pseudonymized session export (privileged accounts + 5k-event sample where applicable)
2) access_review_matrix.xlsx — access recertification exports with manager attestations (we will redact non-MedForge emails)
3) bridge_letter_draft.pdf — draft bridge letter confirming no undisclosed exceptions; place-holder signature line for our legal team

Constraints & notes:
- We will not publish raw email addresses in the session export; emails will be replaced with stable hashed ids.
- Source IPs will be provided as-is; if you require geolocation or ISP mapping please confirm.
- For very large customers we may need an additional 24 hours; given your 2026-03-10 target we will prioritize this bundle and expect to deliver by 2026-03-09 EOD PST.

Delivery method:
- Secure Drive link (shared to the two MedForge recipients listed) + DocuSign envelope for the bridge letter.
- We will provide an MD5 checksum for CSVs for auditor verification.

Action: Clare — please confirm privilege-role definition above and confirm delivery recipients (clare.hall@medforge.com, sara.miller@medforge.com). Once you confirm, Priyom will schedule the export job.

Regards,
Laura Bennett
Head of Compliance, Redwood Inference
laura_bennett@redwood.ai

Attachments: authn_session_sample.csv (CSV stub), access_review_matrix.xlsx (XLSX stub), bridge_letter_draft.pdf (PDF stub)
